shape.situation_pattern: The recurring cadence (digest, rightsize, loop-breaker) fires on a timer, and a threshold of weekly tokens has been spent.
shape.decision: Run cadence deterministically at $0 — never ping a paid model on cadence; over a spend threshold, halt new spawns and go read-only/deterministic.
shape.reasoning_physics: Routine loops should never cost currency; a recurse loop is free. Marks are for real spawned work or a genuine emergency, not for idle pings.
